newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen mixed at start.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen mixed at start.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open mixed on Thursday after a rally on Wednesday which was concentrated in blue chips while the broader market remained mixed.
Analysts said that most of the action will likely once again come during the last hour of trading, when programs are expected to kick in.
"It's the same kind of Dow rally we keep seeing again and again," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities. "Volatility is a way of life."
